scope: Games between two of the 18 SWAC/MEAC programs. Every team and every player; no minimum.
garbage_time: Standard boards include it, like a box score. Pool rows carry value (in) and value_competitive (out); they rank on value.
season_game_rank: Where this single game stands among all single games so far this season (through this week). 1 = best.

players.label: Rushing yards
players.definition: Rushing yards in the game. Sacks are not rushes.

players.label: Total offense
players.definition: Rushing plus passing yards in the game.

players.label: All-purpose yards
players.definition: Rushing, receiving and return yards in the game.

players.label: Tackles
players.definition: Solo plus assisted tackles in the game.

players.label: Tackles for loss
players.definition: Tackles for loss in the game.

teams.label: Total yards allowed
teams.definition: Total yards allowed in the game.

teams.label: Rushing yards allowed
teams.definition: Rushing yards allowed in the game.

teams.label: Passing yards allowed
teams.definition: Passing yards allowed in the game.

teams.label: Yards per play
teams.definition: Total yards / plays in the game.

pool.label: Yards after the catch
pool.definition: Credited yards minus air yards, on completions with a charted catch spot.

pool.label: Plays of 20+ yards
pool.definition: Runs and catches gaining 20+ credited yards.

pool.label: 3rd- and 4th-down conversions
pool.definition: Runs and catches on 3rd or 4th down that kept the ball with a first down or scored.

pool.label: Win chance added
pool.definition: Change in the offense's win chance on the player's runs, throws and catches, in percentage points (win chance after minus before: the real swing, not the capped wpa field). Thrower and catcher both get a catch. Fun to look at, not a precise measure: the feed's clock is loose.

biggest_play.description: 18-yard touchdown catch from C. Brown IV
